reviewNotes: Held back: the bar lines are read off the rhythm (CCEH's Noteworthy score could not be read); check the pickup against the score. Imported from CCEH tune 000528 (the melody read from 000528a.mid, checked against the page's do-re-mi incipit, note for note); check the notes and the bar lines against a hymn book you trust, then set "reviewed": true. George Frederick Handel's dates (1685–1759) are from our page for the tune ANTIOCH (content/hymns/tunes/antioch.json); CCEH's page gives only the year 1728. David Weyman has no death year on CCEH's page or ours; their work is dated 1815, before 1850, so they died before 1955 (they would have been over 105). Lowell Mason's dates (1792–1872) are from our page for the tune BETHANY (content/hymns/tunes/bethany.json); CCEH's page gives only the year 1821.
